```{r}
# Read the node and network data
nodes <- read.csv("../data/Seoul_node_info.csv")
network202202 <- read.csv("../data/monthly/network_202202.csv")

# Create a graph from the merged network data and name it g
g202202 <- graph_from_data_frame(d = network202202, directed = TRUE)

# Set edge weights
E(g202202)$weight <- network202202$strength

# Add gu and dong attributes to each node
V(g202202)$gu <- nodes$gu[match(V(g202202)$name, nodes$node)]
V(g202202)$dong <- nodes$dong[match(V(g202202)$name, nodes$node)]
V(g202202)$population <- nodes$population[match(V(g202202)$name, nodes$node)]
V(g202202)$business <- nodes$business[match(V(g202202)$name, nodes$node)]

# Create the adjacency matrix
adjmatrix <- as_adjacency_matrix(g202202, sparse = FALSE, attr = "weight")
adjnull <- `rownames<-`(`colnames<-`(adjmatrix, NULL), NULL)

seoul_map <- geojson_read("../data/skorea-submunicipalities-2018-topo.json", what = "sp")

# Assume seoul_map is already in sf format, filter Seoul region
seoul_map_11 <- st_as_sf(seoul_map[substr(seoul_map@data$code, 1, 2) == "11", ])

# Extract gu information (first 4 digits of the code)
seoul_map_11 <- seoul_map_11 %>%
  mutate(gu = substr(code, 1, 4))  # Add gu column
# Merge by gu and calculate the boundary of each gu
gu_boundaries <- seoul_map_11 %>%
  group_by(gu) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))  # Merge geometry
gu_boundaries_lines <- st_cast(gu_boundaries, "MULTILINESTRING")

# Calculate node strength (average of all and total strength)
strength_data <- data.frame(
  node = V(g202202)$name, 
  all_strength = strength(g202202, mode = "all", loops = FALSE),
  total_strength = strength(g202202, mode = "total")
) %>%
  mutate(strength = (all_strength + total_strength) / 2) %>%  # Average strength
  dplyr::select(node, strength)

# Load wdnet package for centrality computation
library(wdnet)

# Compute harmonic closeness centrality (outgoing)
myclose_out <- centrality(
  adj = adjmatrix,
  measure = "closeness", 
  closeness.control = list(method = "harmonic", distance = FALSE, mode = "out")
)
myclose_out <- as.data.frame(myclose_out)

# Compute harmonic closeness centrality (incoming)
myclose_in <- centrality(
  adj = adjmatrix,
  measure = "closeness", 
  closeness.control = list(method = "harmonic", distance = FALSE, mode = "in")
)
myclose_in <- as.data.frame(myclose_in)

# Compute Weighted PageRank (WPR) centrality
mywpr_null <- centrality(
  adj = adjmatrix,
  measure = "wpr", 
  wpr.control = list(gamma = 0.85, theta = 1)
)
mywpr_null <- as.data.frame(mywpr_null)

# Combine all centrality measures into one data frame
centrality <- data.frame(
  name = myclose_out$name,
  closeness_out = myclose_out$closeness,
  closeness_in = myclose_in$closeness,
  wpr = mywpr_null$wpr
)

# Merge with node strength
centrality <- centrality %>% 
  left_join(strength_data, by = c("name" = "node"))

# Load required package
library(poweRlaw)

# Perform power-law test for in_strength
strength <- strength_data$strength
strength <- strength / 10000
strength <- floor(strength)

# Create power-law distribution object
m_pl_in <- displ$new(strength)

# Estimate parameters
est_in <- estimate_xmin(m_pl_in)
m_pl_in$setXmin(est_in)

# Set random seed
set.seed(123)

# Perform bootstrap test
bs_in <- bootstrap_p(m_pl_in, no_of_sims = 10, threads = 1)

# Output in-strength results
cat("strength P-value:", bs_in$p, "\n")
cat("strength xmin:", m_pl_in$xmin, "\n")
cat("strength pars (alpha):", m_pl_in$pars, "\n")
cat("strength xmin standard error:", sd(bs_in$bootstraps$xmin), "\n")
cat("strength pars standard error:", sd(bs_in$bootstraps$pars), "\n\n")
cat("Number of dongs exceed the xmin:", sum(strength > m_pl_in$xmin), 
    ", accounting for", sprintf("%.2f%%", sum(strength[strength > m_pl_in$xmin]) / sum(strength) * 100), 
    "of the total strength.\n")

library(ggpubr)

# Calculate the CDF of Strength
cdf_data <- data.frame(
  strength = sort(strength),
  cdf = ecdf(strength)(sort(strength))
)

# Calculate right-tail cumulative distribution (1 - CDF)
cdf_data$tail_cdf <- 1 - cdf_data$cdf

# Plot the right-tail cumulative distribution of Strength
strength_plot <- ggplot(cdf_data, aes(x = strength, y = tail_cdf)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = ifelse(strength >= m_pl_in$xmin, "Above Threshold", "Below Threshold"))) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 10, m_pl_in$xmin), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "Node Strength (log scale)",
    y = "Survival (log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Below Threshold" = "lightblue", "Above Threshold" = "lightcoral")) +
  {
    xmin <- m_pl_in$xmin
    alpha <- m_pl_in$pars
    fitted_x <- seq(xmin, max(cdf_data$strength), length.out = 100)
    fitted_y <- (fitted_x / xmin)^(-alpha + 1)
    y_baseline <- cdf_data$tail_cdf[cdf_data$strength == xmin]
    fitted_y <- fitted_y * y_baseline
    geom_line(data = data.frame(strength = fitted_x, tail_cdf = fitted_y),
              aes(x = strength, y = tail_cdf), color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8)
  } +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m_pl_in$xmin, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

# Save the plot as PNG file
ggsave(filename = "../unique_month_result/Strength_dist_202202.png",  plot = strength_plot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

strength_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = seoul_map_11, aes(fill = factor(strength > m_pl_in$xmin, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))), 
          color = "grey", size = 0.2) +  # dong boundaries in grey
  geom_sf(data = gu_boundaries_lines, color = "black", size = 1.5) +  # gu boundaries in thick black
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "lightcoral", "FALSE" = "lightblue"),  
                    labels = c("Above Threshold", "Below Threshold")) +  # Ensure red on the left
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE, title = NULL))

ggsave(filename = "../unique_month_result/Strength_map202202.png",  plot = strength_map, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")


seoul_map_11 <- seoul_map_11 %>% mutate(Mobility = (strength / sum(strength)) * 2)


# Merge centrality data with map data
seoul_map_11 <- seoul_map_11 %>%
  left_join(centrality, by = c("code" = "name"))
seoul_map_11 <- seoul_map_11 %>%
  left_join(
    nodes %>% 
      mutate(node = as.character(node)) %>%  # 把 node 转字符
      select(node, gu, dong),
    by = c("code" = "node")
  )


top_10 <- seoul_map_11 %>% 
  arrange(desc(wpr)) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  dplyr::select(rank, dong, strength, gu = gu.y, Mobility)


bottom_10 <- seoul_map_11 %>% 
  arrange(wpr) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  dplyr::select(rank, dong, strength, gu = gu.y, Mobility)

write_xlsx(top_10, "../unique_month_result/Top10wpr202202.xlsx")
write_xlsx(bottom_10, "../unique_month_result/Bottom10wpr202202.xlsx")
```

result202001 <- readRDS("/Users/huzeyu/Desktop/UConnHealth/SeoulMobilityNetwork/result/monthly/community_result/community_membership_202001.rds")
result202002 <- readRDS("/Users/huzeyu/Desktop/UConnHealth/SeoulMobilityNetwork/result/monthly/community_result/community_membership_202002.rds")
result202101 <- readRDS("/Users/huzeyu/Desktop/UConnHealth/SeoulMobilityNetwork/result/monthly/community_result/community_membership_202101.rds")
result202102 <- readRDS("/Users/huzeyu/Desktop/UConnHealth/SeoulMobilityNetwork/result/monthly/community_result/community_membership_202102.rds")
result202201 <- readRDS("/Users/huzeyu/Desktop/UConnHealth/SeoulMobilityNetwork/result/monthly/community_result/community_membership_202201.rds")
result202202 <- readRDS("/Users/huzeyu/Desktop/UConnHealth/SeoulMobilityNetwork/result/monthly/community_result/community_membership_202202.rds")
library(mclust)  # for adjustedRandIndex

results <- list(
  `202001` = result202001,
  `202002` = result202002,
  `202101` = result202101,
  `202102` = result202102,
  `202201` = result202201,
  `202202` = result202202
)

n <- length(results)
ari_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n, dimnames = list(names(results), names(results)))

#  pairwise ARI
for (i in 1:n) {
  for (j in 1:n) {
    ari_mat[i, j] <- adjustedRandIndex(results[[i]], results[[j]])
  }
}

ari_mat
